title: Retuning a rate limit refills it: the two-argument setter grants full capacity immediately
description: setRateLimitData(key, maxAmount, slope) delegates with lastAmount = maxAmount and lastUpdated = now, so an admin adjusting a limit also erases whatever the controller had already consumed.
